question_text: What is electrocardiography and what are the normal components of ECG?

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What it is
steps.why: The heart's contraction is driven by an electrical signal, so recording that signal records the beat.
common_mistakes: Saying ECG records the sound of the heart.
Leaving out that it is a recording procedure.
lines: Electrocardiography, ECG, is a procedure for
recording electrical changes in the heart.

steps.label: Its four components
steps.why: Each component measures something different: a wave is one event, an interval the time between two.
common_mistakes: Leaving out the segments or the complex.
steps.margin_note: Name all four with an example each.
lines: 1. Waves — P, Q, R, S and T waves
2. Intervals — P-R, Q-T and R-R intervals

insider_note: Four components are asked for, not three. Waves, intervals, segments and complexes — name an example inside each.
